headlines.title: Lowe's Companies, Inc. to Host Third Quarter 2026 Earnings Conference Call on Nov. 18
headlines.summary: Lowe's Companies, Inc. (NYSE: LOW) announced today that it will hold its Third Quarter 2026 Earnings Conference Call at 9 a.m. Eastern time on Wednesday, Nov. 18. A webcast will be available by visiting the Quarterly Earnings section of the Lowe's Investor Relations website, ir.lowes.com. Supplemental materials will be available 15 minutes before the start of the conference call.

headlines.title: How These 5 Big-Box Retailers Compete for the Same Shopper
headlines.summary: Walmart keeps gaining ground among shoppers of all income levels, but there's still strong potential among the big-box retailer's four key peers.

headlines.title: Lowe's Becomes Exclusive Home Improvement Partner of Bilt, Making Homeownership More Rewarding Through Bilt Neighborhood OS
headlines.summary: Lowe's and Bilt, the neighborhood commerce and rewards platform, today announced a new partnership designed to make caring for and improving a home easier and more rewarding.

headlines.title: Bilt Introduces the Operating System for Neighborhoods, Bilt Neighborhood OS™, Connecting Businesses and Communities to Power Local Commerce
headlines.summary: NEW YORK, November 10, 2026--Bilt today announced the next evolution of its platform, introducing the operating system for neighborhoods – Bilt Neighborhood OS: an AI operating system and commerce network designed to help businesses grow by reaching new customers, building loyalty, and making everyday life more rewarding for the communities around them.

headlines.title: This Dividend King Yielding 2X the S&P 500 Looks Like a Buy in November.
headlines.summary: Buy for the yield, stay for the potential comeback with this home improvement retailer's shares.

description: Lowe's Companies, Inc., together with its subsidiaries, operates as a home improvement retailer in the United States and Canada. It provides a line of products for construction, maintenance, repair, remodeling, and decorating. The company also offers home improvement products, such as appliances, seasonal and outdoor living, lumber, lawn and garden, kitchens and bath, hardware, building materials, millwork, paint, rough plumbing, tools, electrical, flooring, and décor. In addition, it provides installation services through independent contractors in various product categories; and extended protection plans and repair services. Further, the company provides design, distribution, and installation services for interior surface finishes to home builders and property managers. It sells its national brand-name merchandise and private brand products to professional customers, individual homeowners, and renters. The company serves its products through Lowes.com website, mobile applications, retail home improvement stores and outlet stores, and its branches. Lowe's Companies, Inc. was founded in 1921 and is based in Mooresville, North Carolina.
